data.name: Space Commanders: Solar System
data.detailed_description:
A unique journey following a lone space commander who ventures into the silence of the Solar System, exploring the dark surfaces of distant planets and moons to gather scientific data, establish small outposts, and search for new worlds and potential habitats for humanity. In the cold, dark, and isolated void of space, every step becomes a fight for survival.

Each planet offers a distinct atmosphere, temperature, gravity, and lighting environment based on real scientific data. You choose which world to begin your mission on.

You are not entirely alone in your exploration. A stranded spaceship deep in space carries a crew of astronauts waiting for rescue. To reach them, you must collect data across multiple planets, manage your landing craft with precision, and carefully monitor your oxygen levels. When your oxygen runs out, death is inevitable—every movement must be calculated.

You explore planetary surfaces in first‑person, while navigating your spacecraft and landers through third‑person/top‑down perspectives. All items, surface details, and planetary information are grounded in real scientific sources. The game also includes a 30‑question quiz on space history and science, allowing you to reinforce what you learn throughout your journey.

Landable Celestial Bodies: Moon, Mars, Mercury, Triton, Venus, Ganymede.

And of course, Earth remains your indispensable hub for starship upgrades and supplies—because even the toughest commander needs a pit stop!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4–6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a DirectX 12 compatible graphics card.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a DirectX 12 compatible graphics card.
